subject: Re-process the accelerometer output using milestones files

messages.author: a3527f6489543e9b
messages.subject: Re-process the accelerometer output using milestones files
parts:
Dear GGIR community

I have a question about the possibility of re-analysing/processing the accelerometer outputs (e.g., changing the cut-points, valid hours for inclusion) using the milestone data files only (i.e., without the actual data files) obtained from the first round of processing. If this is possible, how should I set up the script?

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Re-process the accelerometer output using milestones files
parts:
Hi John,

The original data files are only needed in the part 1 of the processing, if you already have done that in a previous run of the script, you can skip it by including mode = 2:5, and you can redefine the parameters as you wish (make sure you set overwrite = TRUE so that your previous milestone data is overwritten with the new configuration).

Best,
Jairo
